rule: Portable private evidence and generated Challenge shapes. The v1 wire format is retained for compatibility; study_day is provenance, not a mandatory next-day schedule. This file stores no personal state and is not lexical semantic authority.

compatibility.missing_evidence_fields: Do not fabricate event identity, target revision, task attribution, demand, assistance or novelty. Missing fields limit inference and may require local reconciliation.
compatibility.migration_rule: Legacy Unknown/Fuzzy and whole-card revisit history cannot automatically create full-card Repair. Import old evidence without pretending it proves a new mastery state.

event_fields.word: Optional display spelling; never semantic authority.
event_fields.target_kind: core | sense | collocation | construction | phrase | relation | word_feel | productive_need
event_fields.target_id: Stable Current subobject identity when available.
event_fields.target_locator: Owner-local locator with owner revision/fingerprint when no stable ID exists. An unversioned array index is insufficient for durable inference.
event_fields.source: depth_plus | challenge | reconstruction | reading | cloze | translation | writing | blind_probe
event_fields.outcome: ADDED | CORRECT | WRONG | SLOW | AGAIN | QUESTION_ISSUE | SEMANTIC_ISSUE
event_fields.correct_key: Optional correct spatial answer key, only after the learner answers.
event_fields.question_trace: Optional minimal prompt/options trace for diagnosis; not a replacement semantic owner.
event_fields.note: Optional diagnostic note, never a required ordinary learner action.
event_fields.observed_at: Occurrence time in ISO-8601, distinct from import/export time.

optional_evidence_enrichment.event_id: Stable source event identity for idempotent replay; conflicting reuse is quarantined.
optional_evidence_enrichment.context_id: Identifies repeated versus distinct evidence contexts.
optional_evidence_enrichment.target_revision: Owner revision or target fingerprint when needed to resolve identity.
optional_evidence_enrichment.demand: recognition | discrimination | production when observed and material.
optional_evidence_enrichment.assistance: Observed assistance/answer exposure, not an inferred default of unassisted.
optional_evidence_enrichment.context_novelty: Observed fresh/unseen/repeated context; unavailable is not unseen.
optional_evidence_enrichment.corrects_event_id: Explicit defect/correction linkage when an earlier score must be withdrawn.

rules: Keep exact target references rather than duplicated whole definitions.
Meaningful events inform the next relevant compilation, not a compulsory next-day review queue.
Re-importing one event cannot create additional debt or independent successes.
Whole-card Unknown/Fuzzy routes Depth now and does not by itself admit any Repair target.
A defective question is not learner failure; unresolved target or task attribution cannot silently become vocabulary debt.
Immediate assisted reconstruction is not delayed transfer; a correct English answer is not success for every word in the passage.
Return Packet remains private and must not be committed as shared content.

challenge_fields.target_kind: core | sense | collocation | construction | phrase | relation | word_feel | productive_need
challenge_fields.target_id: Stable Current subobject identity when available.
challenge_fields.source_evidence: Exact local + or qualified target-level failure/uncertainty, or explicitly optional probe. Whole-card Fuzzy alone is not admission evidence.
challenge_fields.question_type: spatial_choice for v1; later versions may add other low-friction forms.
challenge_fields.stem: Generated context from accepted Current semantics. Never consume protected unseen true-exam/TPO material.
challenge_fields.options: 2-4 objects with keys in left | up | right | down and learner-visible text.
challenge_fields.correct_key: One spatial key present in options.
challenge_fields.repair: Optional smallest-sufficient repair shown only after failure.
challenge_fields.reconstruction: Optional one same-session reconstruction, without recursive repair chains; not independent delayed stability evidence.

rules: Generate from valid Current lexical semantics and relations, not one permanent item per sense.
Do not consume unattempted held-out true-exam/TPO source sentences.
Two-choice items normally use left/right; other spatial choices remain consistent.
Arrow choice submits immediately without a ritual second Enter.
Preserve valid failure history even after same-session reconstruction succeeds, but do not turn history retention into an unconditional future test obligation.
Retirement/reactivation compares the same target and relevant demand. Reading recognition cannot automatically clear Writing production weakness.
Challenge packets are private transport, not semantic authority or an obligatory daily ritual.

chat_compile_order: resolve identities, deduplicate and reconcile event chronology/corrections
derive exact target eligibility from local + and qualified meaningful evidence
withdraw stale/invalid debt and consider target/demand-matched later evidence
diagnose repeated failure instead of adding mechanical repetitions
select a small useful Repair subset from current evidence and learner capacity
preserve Coverage continuation; optional probes never become quotas or prerequisites
no_review_debt_rule: Missed days create no due-card debt. Compile from currently valid evidence; no all-due-before-new gate. Opening full Depth can end with zero Repair, and Kian may skip/defer Repair without losing Coverage resume.
